_description: Registry of replay bundles for Robot Ethology. Each entry pairs an arena, two morphologies (robot A and B), and a shared hierarchy into a known-good replay. This is the single source of valid replays regardless of origin: hand-curated bundles AND (eventually) constrained-generation output both append entries here. Entry names are prefixed by origin: 'CB' = curated bundle (hand-authored), 'AG' = auto-generated (constrained generation). The FW-006 instructor tool will read/write this file.
